summary: Direction of the paper's central claim reproduced. The IID Type-I error of 16.9 percent is reachable but only at one unpublished dependence parameter; at that same parameter the paper's HAC figure of 7.2 percent does not reproduce (measured 11.6 percent). The information-growth range 1.75 to 1.94 did not reproduce (measured 2.36 to 2.79). A stronger, AXV-specific finding: the paper's session-centred estimator assumes away between-session mean heterogeneity, and when that assumption is violated the estimator is worse than plain IID.
